integrity: The proof is self-contained. Exact symbolic replay checks all Pauli-correlation tensors and the Gram polynomial identity; no finite search is used to infer the continuous optimization.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes the Higuchi–Sudbery state and Rényi order two; it does not prove global maximality over all four-qubit states or results for other Rényi orders.
The originality search was targeted and may miss a later proof under substantially different terminology.
title: Exact order-two RIU entropy and maximizing product bases of the Higuchi–Sudbery state
